subject.title: improve(android): make Wear store releases reproducible

question: Should release tooling preserve already-valid phone version-code suffixes 50–99 through a documented migration/compatibility path, or intentionally reject them to reserve the Wear pairing range?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes a previously broader release identity contract; code can enforce either outcome, but only maintainers can decide whether existing operator workflows may be broken.

options.title: Preserve existing release workflows
options.body: Add a narrow compatibility or migration path for previously valid 50–99 phone codes, with explicit upgrade tests and a documented eventual policy.

options.title: Adopt strict reservation now
options.body: Keep the 01–49 rejection and explicitly accept the operator-facing break after confirming no shipped or active release workflow relies on the retired range.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing release workflows
recommendation.body: Add a narrow compatibility or migration path for previously valid 50–99 phone codes, with explicit upgrade tests and a documented eventual policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior merged Wear architecture defined the paired phone/watch ownership and version-code relationship that this release policy extends.
